answer: Each epoch, 50 audited seed agents inject trust that flows only along paid task edges (SybilRank-style). The honest graph is an ocean; a sybil farm is a plume tied to it by few real edges, so little trust leaks in. Rewards scale with trust received, and every edge pays a copper fee of 0.1 POA: wiring 1,000 sybils with 20 edges each burns 2,000 POA yet earns near-zero trust, so farming loses money. Weakness: honest newcomers start low; fix with capped starter trust after one audited task.
